protocol.role: post-hoc common-instance evaluation diagnostic; not retuning or equivalence certification
protocol.snapshots: QAOA evaluation trajectories only; reverse replay unavailable because stochastic recordings omit Hamiltonian coefficients
protocol.rng: independent SeedSequence([replay_seed, grid_width, qaoa_seed, decision]) per instance
protocol.bootstrap: 50000 paired trajectory-cluster resamples; 20 trajectories per grid; average three classical replays within each trajectory
